book.omnilogistics.name: OmniLogistics Guide
book.omnilogistics.landing: Component-aware item logistics for 1.21: filter by enchantments and mod data, pipe, expose, route wirelessly, extract.
desc.omnilogistics.basic_void_miner:
Mines ore out of nothing: FE in, ore out. Logistics Card = filter, Bandwidth Upgrades x3 (x2 items and FE per cycle each), redstone pauses.
Tier 1/4: 200 ticks per cycle by default (type your own, 1-200) and 2k FE per cycle.
desc.omnilogistics.advanced_void_miner:
Mines ore out of nothing: FE in, ore out. Logistics Card = filter, Bandwidth Upgrades x3 (x2 items and FE per cycle each), redstone pauses.
Tier 2/4: 100 ticks per cycle by default (type your own, 1-200) and 8k FE per cycle, quartz, diamonds and emeralds appear.
desc.omnilogistics.elite_void_miner:
Mines ore out of nothing: FE in, ore out. Logistics Card = filter, Bandwidth Upgrades x3 (x2 items and FE per cycle each), redstone pauses.
Tier 3/4: 50 ticks per cycle by default (type your own, 1-200) and 32k FE per cycle, amethyst and ancient debris appear.
desc.omnilogistics.ultimate_void_miner:
Mines ore out of nothing: FE in, ore out. Logistics Card = filter, Bandwidth Upgrades x3 (x2 items and FE per cycle each), redstone pauses.
Tier 4/4: 25 ticks per cycle by default (type your own, 1-200) and 128k FE per cycle, the richest table.
desc.omnilogistics.inventory_exposer:
Shows a filtered view of the inventory on its target face.
AE2 / RS / pipes only see items that pass the filter.
desc.omnilogistics.wireless_router: Holds 8 cards + 2 upgrades. Moves items and FE to and from bound blocks without cables.
desc.omnilogistics.component_extractor:
Base: moves enchantments onto books. Modules add gem extraction and fusion.
Needs FE. Gear stays in its lane and is transformed in place.
desc.omnilogistics.logistics_card:
Sneak + right-click a block to bind. Right-click in air to configure.
EXTRACT pulls from the block, INSERT pushes into it. Craft with Bandwidth Upgrades to overclock.
desc.omnilogistics.wrench:
Pipe arm: cycle NORM / EXTRACT / INSERT / OFF. Pipe centre: redstone mode. Exposer face: set target.
Sneak + right-click: pick up the block with everything inside. Any c:tools/wrench works.
tooltip.omnilogistics.mode.pipe: Click to cycle. The label says what the pipe does to the block on that side: NORM (connected, accepts and delivers), EXTRACT (the pipe takes items out of that block, green arm), INSERT (the pipe only puts items into that block, orange arm), OFF (disconnected)
tooltip.omnilogistics.mode.exposer: Pick the side whose inventory is exposed (filtered) on all other sides
tooltip.omnilogistics.mode.card: EXTRACT: take items out of the bound block into the router. INSERT: put the router buffer into the bound block
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.match_item: Item must be the same as one of the filter items (a 4 / 16 / 64 card holds several; any of them is enough)
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.match_compone: Components must match the filter item exactly
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.match_enchant: Item must carry every enchantment of the filter item at that level or higher. Put an enchanted book here and turn Match Item off to catch any gear with those enchantments
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.has_enchants: Item must carry enchantments (works with an empty filter slot)
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.mod_component: Item must carry components from another mod, e.g. Apotheosis affixes or gems (works with an empty filter slot)
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.invert: Blacklist: let through everything that does NOT match
tooltip.omnilogistics.card_unbound: Unbound. Sneak + right-click a block to bind - any face will do
gui.omnilogistics.pick_tag: Pick item tags of the filter item
gui.omnilogistics.pick_empty: Put an item in the filter slot first
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.match_tag: Item must be in ANY of the tags you picked from the filter item (Tags button below)
tooltip.omnilogistics.flag.match_selecte: Only the components you picked (Comps button below) must equal the filter item, everything else is ignored
tooltip.omnilogistics.pick_tag: Lists every item tag the filter item is in. Pick as many as you like; the item passes if it is in any of them
tooltip.omnilogistics.pick_components: Lists every Data Component on the filter item with its value: item defaults (max_damage, rarity, attribute_modifiers...) and stamped-on ones marked with *. Tick the ones that must match exactly
gui.omnilogistics.pick_hint: Scroll / arrows: move   Enter or click: add / remove   Esc: close
gui.omnilogistics.component_patched: * changed on this item (default components are listed too)
desc.omnilogistics.basic_item_pipe:
Moves items. Faces: NORM (connected), EXTRACT (takes out of that block, green), INSERT (only puts into it, orange), OFF.
Right-click an end of the run to set faces and drop in a Logistics Card as filter. No card = plain pipe.
desc.omnilogistics.advanced_item_pipe:
Moves items. Faces: NORM (connected), EXTRACT (takes out of that block, green), INSERT (only puts into it, orange), OFF.
Right-click an end of the run to set faces and drop in a Logistics Card as filter. No card = plain pipe.
desc.omnilogistics.elite_item_pipe:
Moves items. Faces: NORM (connected), EXTRACT (takes out of that block, green), INSERT (only puts into it, orange), OFF.
Right-click an end of the run to set faces and drop in a Logistics Card as filter. No card = plain pipe.
desc.omnilogistics.ultimate_item_pipe:
Moves items. Faces: NORM (connected), EXTRACT (takes out of that block, green), INSERT (only puts into it, orange), OFF.
Right-click an end of the run to set faces and drop in a Logistics Card as filter. No card = plain pipe.
desc.omnilogistics.basic_energy_cable:
Moves FE. Set IN on the generator side; everything else connected receives.
Right-click an end of the run for face and redstone modes, or use the wrench.

Moves FE. Set IN on the generator side; everything else connected receives.
Right-click an end of the run for face and redstone modes, or use the wrench.

Moves fluids. Set IN on the tank side; everything else connected receives.
Right-click an end of the run for face and redstone modes, or use the wrench.
desc.omnilogistics.advanced_fluid_pipe:
Moves fluids. Set IN on the tank side; everything else connected receives.

desc.omnilogistics.energy_card:
Wireless FE. Sneak + right-click a machine to bind, right-click in air to flip mode.
EXTRACT drains it into the router, INSERT charges it from the router.
desc.omnilogistics.speed_upgrade:
Router: x2 card actions per cycle per copy (max 3).
Void Miner: x2 items and FE per cycle per copy (max 3).
Component Extractor: halves the FE per operation per copy (max 3).
Speed itself is free: type the tick rate straight into the machine.
desc.omnilogistics.parallel_upgrade: Extractor: unlocks one more lane per copy (max 2), items process in parallel.
desc.omnilogistics.gem_module:
Extractor: also pulls items embedded in modded components out of gear.
Apotheosis gems, and anything stored the same way.
desc.omnilogistics.fusion_module:
Extractor: unlocks FUSE mode.
Donor enchantments and modded components merge onto the gear.
tooltip.omnilogistics.extractor_mode: EXTRACT: enchantments to books (+ gems with the Component Module). FUSE: merge the donor slot onto the gear. Needs a Fusion Module
tooltip.omnilogistics.miner_card: Logistics Card: only items passing its filter are kept. Right-click the card here to edit it. A miss still spends the cycle.
tooltip.omnilogistics.miner_upgrade: Bandwidth Upgrade (up to 3): each doubles the items - and the FE - per cycle.
jei.omnilogistics.note_gems: Component Module: gems out of modded gear
jei.omnilogistics.note_fuse: Fusion Module, FUSE mode: donor onto gear
jei.omnilogistics.pipe_tiers: Tiers: 8 / 32 / 128 / 512 items per move, 2k / 8k / 32k / 128k FE per tick, 1 / 4 / 16 / 64 buckets per move. Wrap 8 pipes around gold, diamond or netherite to tier up.
jei.omnilogistics.exposer: Place next to any inventory, pick the target face. Storage buses, hoppers and pipes on the other faces see only items passing the filter.
jei.omnilogistics.router: Cards reach blocks up to 64 away (more with Antenna Upgrades). Bandwidth Upgrades double how many card actions fit in one cycle; the tick field sets the pace.
jei.omnilogistics.extractor: Four upgrade slots: Bandwidth x3 (cheaper operations), Lane x2, Component Module, Fusion Module. The tick field sets the pace.
jei.omnilogistics.miner: Every cycle rolls its tier loot table (datapack: omnilogistics:miner/<tier>). A Logistics Card in the slot filters the result. Output auto-ejects to neighbours. The tick field sets the cycle length.
jei.omnilogistics.card: Filter by item, tag, enchantments or any data component, chosen from the reference item. Craft with Bandwidth Upgrades to overclock (x2 / x4 / x8).
desc.omnilogistics.infinity_item_pipe: Creative only. Moves 65536 items every tick.
desc.omnilogistics.fluid_card:
EXTRACT / INSERT fluid against the bound tank.
Drop a bucket (or any filled container) into a reference slot and only that fluid passes; four references, or a fluid tag.
desc.omnilogistics.void_card:
Destroys matching items that reach the router buffer.
Right-click in air to set the filter.
desc.omnilogistics.vacuum_card: Pulls matching dropped items around the router (or the bound block) into the buffer.
desc.omnilogistics.activator_card: Right-clicks the bound block face with the buffer item, like a player.
desc.omnilogistics.breaker_card: Breaks the bound block; drops go into the router buffer.
desc.omnilogistics.placer_card: Places the buffer item as a block at the bound position.
desc.omnilogistics.detector_card: Router emits redstone 15 while the bound inventory holds a matching item.
tooltip.omnilogistics.redstone: Redstone: Always / only with a signal / only without a signal. Gates pulling and delivering for this conduit
tooltip.omnilogistics.filter_card: Put a Logistics Card here: the pipe then only moves items that pass the card's filter. Right-click the card to edit it in place. Empty slot = everything passes.
jei.omnilogistics.miner_default: Mod default table. A datapack override of omnilogistics:miner/<tier> is not shown here.
desc.omnilogistics.batch_distributor:
Six lanes, one Logistics Card each: an AE2 Pattern Provider pushes one whole pattern in and every ingredient goes to its own machine.
Sneak + right-click a machine face with a card to bind that lane. EXTRACT on a card turns its lane into the return path.
tooltip.omnilogistics.distributor_status: Empty lane. Put a Logistics Card here and sneak + right-click the machine face it should feed.
This card is not bound yet. Sneak + right-click the machine face it should feed.
Ready and waiting for the next batch.
Holding an ingredient. It goes out on the next tick; if it stays, the destination is full or gone.
An earlier lane already matches this filter, so it takes these items first. Give the lanes different filters.
jei.omnilogistics.distributor: Feed a multi-input machine from ONE AE2 Pattern Provider: six lanes, one card each, each ingredient to its own machine. EXTRACT on a card sends the product back.
desc.omnilogistics.advanced_logistics_ca:
A Logistics Card that whitelists 4 different items instead of 1. Works everywhere a Logistics Card does.
Craft it with a card + gold ingot; the card keeps its filter and binding.
desc.omnilogistics.elite_logistics_card:
A Logistics Card that whitelists 16 different items instead of 1.
Craft it with a Gilded card + diamond; the card keeps its filter and binding.
desc.omnilogistics.ultimate_logistics_ca:
A Logistics Card that whitelists 64 different items instead of 1.
Craft it with a Crystal card + netherite ingot; the card keeps its filter and binding.
jei.omnilogistics.multi_card: Same card with more reference slots: 4 / 16 / 64. A stack passes if it matches ANY of them; the flags below still apply. Upgrade in the crafting grid with a gold ingot, a diamond or a netherite ingot - the filter and the binding are kept.
tooltip.omnilogistics.distributor_mode:
SPLIT: one ingredient per lane, each to its own machine - for a recipe whose inputs live in several places.
CLUSTER: the whole batch to one machine, the next batch to the next machine - put 5 identical machines around it and one Pattern Provider feeds all five, so the craft runs 5x faster.
tooltip.omnilogistics.distributor_status: Locked. Add a Lane Upgrade (+3 lanes each, up to 12).
Learning: no filter yet, so this lane claims the first ingredient that arrives and keeps it. Run the craft once and the filter fills itself.
desc.omnilogistics.machine_monitor:
A screen for any machine, from any mod: energy, fluid and the first item stacks.
Right-click it with a Logistics Card that is bound to that machine; right-click empty-handed to take the card back.
msg.omnilogistics.monitor_unbound: That card is not bound to anything yet
jei.omnilogistics.monitor: Reads the bound block through plain capabilities, so it shows machines from any mod. Range is the router range (64 by default).
tooltip.omnilogistics.interval: Ticks per operation: type anything from %s to %s. No upgrade needed, Enter to apply.
tooltip.omnilogistics.distributor_bind: Bind one machine by hand, then press this: every identical machine within %s blocks gets the same lanes, using the blank cards already in the free lanes.
desc.omnilogistics.stock_card:
Keeps the bound inventory topped up to one stack of what the router is carrying.
Craft it with Bandwidth Upgrades to keep 2 / 4 / 8 stacks. Feed the router with an EXTRACT card on a chest.
jei.omnilogistics.stock_card: Pair it with an item card in EXTRACT mode: that one fills the router buffer, this one keeps the machine stocked and stops once the target holds enough.
jade.omnilogistics.router_crossdim: %s cards in another dimension (%s FE each)
jei.omnilogistics.crossdim: A card bound in another dimension keeps working: carry it there, sneak + right-click the block, bring it back. Each action across dimensions costs the router extra FE (config: crossDimensionFE).
desc.omnilogistics.chunk_upgrade: Router: keeps its own chunk and the chunks of its bound cards ticking while you are away (up to 9, config).
jei.omnilogistics.fluid_filter: Fluid filters name their fluid with a container: a water bucket in the reference slot means water. The same card slot is on every fluid conduit, so a pipe can carry one fluid only.
jei.omnilogistics.autoface: Auto input / auto output: a card names a BLOCK, not a face. We try the face you clicked first, then the other five, then the block's unsided view, and use whichever actually takes or gives the item - no side configuration on the machine, and a two-input machine like the Metallurgic Infuser needs no special setup.
msg.omnilogistics.card_upgraded: %s - the crafting recipe is yours now
advancement.omnilogistics.card_upgrade.d: Hold a Logistics Card in one hand and gold in the other, then hold right-click. You can craft this now - put it in a crafting table, or in your automation.
jei.omnilogistics.card_upgrade: By hand: card in one hand, the tier core in the other - gold makes it Gilded (4 references), diamond Crystal (16), netherite Netherforged (64) - then HOLD right-click for two and a half seconds. The card keeps its filter, its binding, its mode and its overclock. The crafting recipe on the left does exactly the same thing and works in any automation - the hand version is there so you see it happen once.
tooltip.omnilogistics.card_locate: Hold it and press %s to make it flash
key.omnilogistics.locate: Flash the block this card is bound to
msg.omnilogistics.locate_none: This card is not bound to anything yet
gui.omnilogistics.nbt.title: NBT rules
gui.omnilogistics.nbt.empty: No rules yet. Put an item in the first filter slot, press + Pick and click any value inside it - durability, an enchantment level, a mod's stored energy. It becomes a rule you can then turn into >=, != or contains.
gui.omnilogistics.nbt.hint: Box on/off - click op or value to edit
gui.omnilogistics.nbt.pick_title: Click a value to make it a rule
gui.omnilogistics.nbt.pick_hint: * = changed from the item's default   Esc / ‹: back
tooltip.omnilogistics.pick_nbt: Rules on the item's own data. Pick any value inside the reference item (damage, an enchantment level, a mod's energy or custom data) and it becomes a rule: equal, not equal, greater or less than, present, absent, or contains. Works with no reference item as well - the rules alone then decide.
tooltip.omnilogistics.nbt.all_any:
ALL: every rule must hold.
ANY: one holding rule is enough.
tooltip.omnilogistics.nbt.any_index: Click: this list position <-> any element of the list
tooltip.omnilogistics.nbt.op:
Left click: next operator
Right click: previous
= and != compare numbers by value (5b, 5 and 5.0 are equal)
contains contains: text inside a text, an element of a list, a key of a compound
